now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6#13
now.text: After Sarge, who turned his sword on Daisy during their truce, stabs May, Daisy comes for revenge, and her quakes expose his true form so Mack can kill him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Inhuman who fights Sarge and helps bring him down.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A man with Coulson's face, who stabs May. Daisy helps bring him down.

proposed.text: After Sarge stabs May, Daisy blames herself for trusting him and fights him at the temple. Her quakes have no effect on him, and Mack kills him with the sword May throws over.

changes.evidence: New Life (S6#13): Daisy blames herself for trusting Sarge after he stabs May; 'Sarge turns out to be unaffected by Quake's powers'; May kills Izel with Sarge's sword and tosses it to Mack, who slays Sarge. Nothing shows Sarge turning his sword on Daisy during the truce (he stabs May in S6#12), and her quakes do not expose his true form.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#3
now.text: In 1931, Sibyl's Chronicom Hunters try to kill Freddy, and S.H.I.E.L.D. saves him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Chronicom whose Hunters try to kill Freddy.

proposed.text: Sibyl hears from her Hunters that their plan to kill Freddy in 1931 failed after S.H.I.E.L.D. saved him, and she sets a new plan in motion in 1955.

changes.evidence: The Hunters' attempt on Freddy and S.H.I.E.L.D.'s rescue happen in 1931 in The New Deal / Know Your Onions (S7#1-2). In Alien Commies from the Future! (S7#3, 1955), Sibyl first appears: Luke and Abel talk to her about the failure of their plan to kill Freddy Malick and move on to Helius. Freddy is not in S7#3; Sibyl is not on screen before it, so the fix keeps the title and gives S7#3's event.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#8
now.text: Kora is Daisy's half-sister, Jiaying's daughter, alive in the history the Chronicoms change.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#10
proposed.text: Daisy learns that Kora, who has sided with Nathaniel Malick, is her half-sister, a daughter of Jiaying who died before Daisy was born in the original history. Captured by Coulson, Kora says she wanted to meet her sister.

changes.evidence: In After, Before (S7#8) Daisy never meets Kora or learns of her; only Jiaying, May and Yo-Yo deal with Kora at Afterlife. In Stolen (S7#10) 'Daisy learns that Kora is her half-sister, who died before Daisy was born in the original timeline', and Kora, captured by Coulson, says she wanted to meet her sister.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#11
now.text: In 1983, a younger John Garrett working with Nathaniel Malick captures Deke and tortures him for Fitz's whereabouts, even in front of his grandmother Jemma. Deke refuses to give him anything.
now.on_a_card_about_b: In 1983, a younger man who tortures Deke for Fitz's whereabouts.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A captive Garrett tortures for Fitz's whereabouts, who gives him nothing.

proposed.text: In 1983, a younger John Garrett working with Nathaniel Malick beats up a captive Deke in front of his grandmother Jemma, to force her to reveal where Fitz is.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: In 1983, a younger man who beats Deke to make Jemma talk.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A captive Garrett beats up to make Jemma reveal Fitz's whereabouts.

changes.evidence: Brand New Day (S7#11): Deke is caught hiding on the Zephyr; Malick has Garrett bring in Shaw 'as added motivation' and 'Garrett beats up Shaw in an attempt to get Simmons to talk'. Deke is leverage on Simmons, not the one questioned for Fitz's location (he does not know it).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#12
now.text: Daniel Sousa joins the team after they save him from his own death in 1955. He and Daisy Johnson fall for each other while fighting the Chronicoms across time.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's love, rescued from his 1955 death to fight beside her across time.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Sousa's love, met when the team saves him from his death in 1955.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S7#9
proposed.text: Trapped in a time loop, Daniel stays at Daisy's side and helps her try to save the team. Before one reset she kisses him, and for the first time in over a hundred loops he is surprised.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Sousa's love, who first meets him at Area 51 in 1955.

changes.evidence: The stage sums up the whole of S7 (Sousa joins in S7#4, the two fall for each other) on The End Is at Hand (S7#12), where little passes between them beyond escaping the Chronicom ship. The romance turns in As I Have Always Been (S7#9): Sousa helps Daisy through the loop and she kisses him passionately; by S7#11 Daisy tells Mack about the kiss and Mack gives Sousa a big-brother talk. The b-card line says they met when the team saved him, but they first meet at Area 51 in S7#3, where Daisy, undercover, wins him over.

owner_calls.question: Daisy and Sousa's connection has a single stage. They meet at Area 51 (S7#3), are teammates from S7#4, are captured together by Nathaniel (S7#5-6), kiss in the time loop (S7#9) and end up exploring space together (S7#13). Add earlier ally stages (S7#3 or S7#4) before the partner stage?
options: Add an ally stage at S7#3 (Daisy, posing as a CIA agent, wins Sousa over and gets him to release her teammates) and keep the partner stage at S7#9
Keep a single partner stage at S7#9 as proposed
owner_calls.evidence: S7#3: 'Daisy arrives undercover and convinces Sousa to release her teammates'; S7#6: Sousa carries Daisy out of Nathaniel's barn; S7#9: Daisy kisses Sousa; S7#13: 'Daisy is exploring the cosmos with Sousa and Kora'.
